text:
Carla Nguyen: quick sync — runtime is landing per-op quant profiles but fused kernels (attn+ffn) inherit single profile. this caused quality blips in shadow runs. do we want per-op overrides for fused paths or force de-fusion when profiles mismatch?

Ben Ortiz: what's the invariant we can rely on? fusion currently assumes homogeneous dtype.

Alice Park: +1 worried about perf hit if we de-fuse. can we do on-the-fly cast inside fused kernel?

Dan Miller: doing casts inside kernel is expensive and complicates cache/kvc. also calibration stats get messy.

Emily Zhao: data point: shadow test on conv+relu fused showed 1.6% accuracy drop when fusing fp8-attn + int8-ffn nonuniform. link: <shadow-run/273>.

Ben Ortiz: proposal draft: prefer fusion when profiles compatible (same bitwidth and scale class), otherwise runtime adds lightweight glue that routes ops to separate kernels but preserves KV cache layout.

Carla Nguyen: glue + routing sounds acceptable. need API surface for per-op acceptable-degradation thresholds. suggest config:

```
quant_profiles:
  default: fp8-e4m3
  per_op:
    matmul: int8-symmetric
    attention_qk: fp8-e4m3
compatibility:
  fusion_allowed_if:
    - bitwidth: same
    - scale_family: same
  fallback_action: split_kernels # or decompose
```

Dan Miller: also need hysteresis to avoid oscillation under noisy telemetry. e.g., require N consecutive requests with quality metric < threshold before split.

Emily Zhao: agree. add telemetry metric: fidelity_score, with sampling at 0.5% and end-to-end BLEU/EM proxies.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for per-op-routing v1 on region-us-west2 (canary id c-8821).

Alice Park: we should also add a fast path: if fused kernel author implements per-op-format annotations, runtime can call a slightly different kernel variant instead of full split.

Carla Nguyen: action items: Dan to prototype glue routing and hysteresis, Alice to spec kernel variant contract, Emily to add fidelity sampling probes, Ben to update RFC wording. ping back by EOD Friday.

Ben Ortiz: noting possible perf delta ~5-12% for split path on p4d — need perf tests.

Carla Nguyen: thanks, will track in RFC PR. :thumbsup:
